svg.title: Polyarthritis (four or more joints): decide inflammatory or degenerative and acute or chronic; acute inflammatory polyarthritis is infection, crystals or early autoimmune disease, and chronic polyarthritis is sorted by its joint pattern into rheumatoid arthritis, psoriatic arthritis, axial spondyloarthropathy and osteoarthritis, each with its own extra-articular clues and targeted tests
